_how: Maintenance switch for every version of Blipville. Set one to true to close it: players see the message below until it's false again. classic = Blipville.exe, redux = Blipville-Redux.exe, web = the website version (go/). Apps check about every 5 minutes (every minute while closed); the website every 2 minutes. Updates still work while closed. link and link_text add a button (leave link empty for none). Easiest way: Actions -> Maintenance mode -> Run workflow.
message: Blipville is getting ready for 1.0! 🎉 Everything opens again on Sunday, November 22, with Blipville 1.0: new Blips, the Arena, friendship, Cookie Catch and lots more. See you there! 💜
